title: gme332: reproducibility code for the exact genuine-multipartite-entanglement threshold of the asymmetric (3,3,2) GHZ state
description: Exact certificates (rational arithmetic in Q(sqrt m)), symmetry-reduced primal and dual PPT-mixture SDPs for the 2 x d x d GHZ family, Lindblad dynamics, a noisy-device simulation and a re-analysis of the published (3,3,2) photonic data of Malik et al. (2016). Reproduces every number and figure of the accompanying paper.
